The '''Coruscant Security Force assault ship''' was an [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].

==History==
They were used during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] to help round up civilians who refused to stay inside and away from the battle. They were adapted and also used by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
